## Summary

Describe the problem and the approach used to solve it.

## Validation

List the commands, manual checks, and environments used to verify the change.

## Screenshots

Include before/after screenshots for visual changes, or write "Not applicable."

## Checklist

- [ ] `swift build -Xswiftc -warnings-as-errors` succeeds
- [ ] `swift run FluentKitValidation` passes
- [ ] Public API changes are documented
- [ ] Visual changes include Gallery coverage and updated snapshots
- [ ] Accessibility, RTL, High Contrast, and Reduce Motion were considered
- [ ] No Microsoft WinUI source code was copied or redistributed
